scores.rationale: Technical claims (pgvector, hybrid search with reranker, output link filtering, ZDR agreements, alias rollback) are sound; minor gaps such as deletions and per-user filtering not detailed.

scores.rationale: Covers core needs, defers account-specific and multilingual explicitly, buildable; but gated docs and deletion handling are thin.

scores.rationale: Validation is tied to specific risks, thresholds labeled as assumptions, early V0/V1, shadow mode, CI evals, and canary continuing in production.

scores.evidence: I assume public. If some are gated, retrieval needs per-user access checks, and that becomes an R3 risk dependency in Phase 2.

scores.rationale: Covers injection, exfiltration, provider outage, runaway cost, poisoning, stale content, and degraded reply; deletions/retractions and duplicates are not explicitly handled.

scores.rationale: Caps, build-vs-buy and V4 economic gate are present, but no per-conversation cost estimate, no caching, and no scaling reasoning.

scores.evidence: one service, not microservices; synchronous streaming, not async; ... Routing | Not needed: one model plus a fallback
scores.rationale: Starts simple with a single service and Postgres, no tools or agents, and defers extras; reranker and hybrid search are added only in the phase gated by evaluation.

scores.evidence: Phase 0 ... The one real request: an internal staff member asks "How do I reset my password?"
scores.rationale: A walking skeleton first, then phases with dependencies, exit checks and rollback, and fallbacks if checks fail.

checklist.evidence: Re-index on each CMS publish, plus a full rebuild nightly; changes live in ≤1 h (ASSUMPTION)
Chunk by heading, combine keyword and vector search, add a reranker.
Run the eval suite in CI whenever a prompt, model or index changes.
≥95% of answers faithful to their cited source; 0 wrong policy statements ... ≥90% correct handoffs on out-of-scope questions
billing and account questions, safety topics, low retrieval scores, and user requests for a person all create a ticket.
user text and retrieved text are wrapped as data, never treated as instructions; no tools
I assume public. If some are gated, retrieval needs per-user access checks
Mask personal data before logs and eval storage; keep transcripts 30 days (ASSUMPTION); never train on them
no actions on accounts ... Answers that use the customer's account (login, order lookup): pulled forward when this is wanted.
Send flagged answers to a queue that the Support lead reviews. Only reviewed corrections enter the eval set or the docs.
Enforce per-conversation and daily cost caps, a timeout, and a degraded reply
